title: China Price Check: Tower of London £37 vs a $6 Great Wall | China Travel Expert
description:
England charges £37 to walk into its royal fortress. China's Great Wall at Mutianyu? ¥40 — under $6. Same idea, about eight times the price.

The Tower of London's adult ticket is £37 (around $49). The standard adult entry to the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall is ¥40 — about $6. Both are walled heritage fortifications you pay to walk; one costs roughly 8× the other. Both prices were checked today.

🧭 Expert Tip: Mutianyu is usually quieter than Badaling and has a cable car up and a toboggan down — foreigners need a passport to book the entry ticket.

伦敦塔门票37英镑（约49美元）；慕田峪长城门票40元，约6美元——同样是城墙古迹，价差约八倍。两边价格今天都已核实。
